m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into chips, toss with a good drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt on a lined tray, and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Slice {chk_breast} in half horizontally so you have thin, even pieces that cook quickly. Set up three shallow bowls: {flour} seasoned with salt, {eggs} beaten with a splash of water, and {panko}.
Coat each piece in flour, then egg, then crumbs, pressing them on firmly. If anyone's gluten free, crumb theirs first with their own flour, egg and crumbs.
Heat 1cm of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in batches for 3 minutes a side until deep golden, then move to a lined tray. It finishes cooking in the oven.

Mix {passata} with {oregano} and a pinch of salt. Spoon over each schnitzel, then top with {ham} and {mozz}. Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the chicken is cooked through (75°C in the thickest part).
Chop {cos} and {cucumber}, and dress with the juice of {lemon}, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt. Serve the parmas with the chips and salad.

l: Slice the parma into strips and pack with salad. Reheat in the oven or air fryer, never the microwave, to keep it crunchy. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF flour and breadcrumbs, crumbed first and fried in fresh oil or a separate pan. Check the ham.
